latinEntries.meaning: a thing dug from the earth

definition_zh: 交换；互换；用…替换；把…换掉
definition_en: to give something to someone and receive something in return, or to replace one thing with another
core_image: 两只手同时递出和接回：东西在掌心之间换了个位置
scene: 午休时，小丽不想吃自己盒饭里的鸡腿，隔壁的同学正好爱吃鸡腿。 They agreed to swap the chicken leg for a piece of chocolate cake.
sceneCN: 这里 swap 是「交换、互换」（第 1 个义项：拿一样东西换另一样东西）；句意是他们商量好用鸡腿换一块巧克力蛋糕。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加表示动作者的后缀 -er 构成，义为「交换者」，使用频率较低
复合名词，义为「旧货交换集市」，主要见于美式英语

senses.title: To exchange one thing for another
senses.definition: to give one thing to someone and receive a different thing in return
senses.definitionCN: 把一样东西给别人，同时换回另一样东西
senses.example: The kids swapped baseball cards during recess.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在课间交换棒球卡。
senses.why: The core image of two hands passing things in opposite directions naturally gives the basic meaning of exchanging items.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是两只手朝相反方向递东西，最自然地长出「拿物换物」这一基本义。

senses.title: To replace one thing with another
senses.definition: to take one thing out of a place or role and put a different thing there instead
senses.definitionCN: 把一样东西从某个位置或用途中拿走，换成另一样
senses.example: You should swap the flat tire for the spare one.
senses.exampleCN: 你应该把爆胎换上备用胎。
senses.why: Once two things trade positions, the thing left behind has been replaced, extending the sense from mutual exchange to substitution.
senses.whyCN: 两样东西换了位置之后，原来的东西就被换下来了，词义由「互换取物」延伸为「替换」。

senses.title: To exchange information or words
senses.definition: to share news, ideas, or remarks with someone in a back-and-forth way
senses.definitionCN: 以一来一往的方式与某人分享消息、想法或说话
senses.example: The two scientists swapped opinions for hours.
senses.exampleCN: 两位科学家交流观点聊了几个小时。
senses.why: Conversation is itself an exchange: words travel back and forth like the objects in the core image.
senses.whyCN: 交谈本身就是一种往来，话语像核心意象中的物件一样来回传递，于是长出「交流、交谈」的抽象义。

senses.title: To trade shifts, roles, or duties
senses.definition: to agree with someone that each of you will do the other's shift, role, or task
senses.definitionCN: 与对方约定各自接替对方的班次、角色或任务
senses.example: Can I swap shifts with you next Friday?
senses.exampleCN: 下周五我能和你换个班吗？
senses.why: A duty can be handed over just like a physical object, so the exchange image applies to jobs and roles.
senses.whyCN: 职责可以像实物一样被交到另一个人手里，交换的意象便套用在班次与角色上。

senses.title: An act of exchanging things
senses.definition: an occasion when two people or groups exchange things
senses.definitionCN: 双方互相交换东西的一次行为或场合
senses.example: The deal was a swap of oil for grain.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔交易是用石油换粮食。
senses.why: A repeated action becomes a noun: the whole event of two hands passing things gets named.
senses.whyCN: 动作反复发生便被命名，两手互递东西的整个事件凝固为名词「一次交换」。

senses.title: A thing that has been exchanged
senses.definition: the item received in an exchange, especially in children's games or collections
senses.definitionCN: 在交换中拿到的东西，多见于儿童游戏或收藏活动
senses.example: She showed me her swaps from the sticker fair.
senses.exampleCN: 她给我看她从贴纸集市换来的宝贝。
senses.why: The result of the exchange, not the act itself, becomes the thing talked about, a regular noun shift.
senses.whyCN: 被谈论的对象从「交换这件事」转到「换回来的结果」，是名词义从动作到结果的常规转移。

senses.title: To change one choice or plan for another
senses.definition: to decide to use or do something different from what was first planned or chosen
senses.definitionCN: 决定改用或改做与最初计划、选择不同的事
senses.example: We swapped the indoor picnic for a restaurant dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 我们放弃了室内野餐，改成去餐厅吃饭。
senses.why: Plans sit in the mind like objects in a hand; changing a plan is mentally putting one down and picking up another.
senses.whyCN: 计划像握在手中的东西，改换计划就是把一个放下、把另一个拿起，意象从实物移到抽象决定。

senses.title: To exchange currencies or financial instruments
senses.definition: in finance, to exchange one stream of payments, currency, or interest rates for another under an agreement
senses.definitionCN: 在金融领域，按协议把一种现金流、货币或利率换成另一种
senses.example: The two banks signed a currency swap agreement.
senses.exampleCN: 两家银行签署了货币互换协议。
senses.why: Finance borrows the everyday exchange image and fixes it as a technical term for exchanging streams of money.
senses.whyCN: 金融借用了日常交换的画面，把「互换来去」固定为交换资金流的术语。

senses.title: To swap over or swap round
senses.definition: to make two things trade places so that each occupies the other's former position
senses.definitionCN: 让两样东西互换位置，各自占据对方原来的地方
senses.example: The teacher swapped the two desks round to make more space.
senses.exampleCN: 老师把两张课桌对调位置，好腾出更多空间。
senses.why: The phrase emphasizes the result of the exchange: the two items have literally traded positions.
senses.whyCN: 短语强调交换的结果：两样东西确实互换了位置，是「交换」义向空间格局的落实。

intro.en: Swap is a native English word whose earlier history is uncertain; it belongs to a small family of verbs describing hitting or moving back and forth, and its modern sense of exchanging appears to have developed from the idea of two things striking or crossing.
intro.cn: swap 是英语本土词，更早的来历不确定；它属于一小族描写击打或来回摆动的动词，现代「交换」义一般认为是由「两物相击、来去交错」的画面发展而来。

items.en: The verb swappen appears, meaning to strike or to move with a swinging or sweeping motion.
items.cn: 中世纪英语出现动词 swappen，意为击打，或以摆动、挥动的方式移动。

items.en: The extended senses 'to dash' and 'to strike down' are recorded; the word also begins to describe back-and-forth motion.
items.cn: 十六世纪记录了「猛冲、击倒」等引申义；这个词也开始描写一来一往的动作。

items.en: The exchange sense develops, first in informal use; some older dictionaries long treated it as slang, a sign of its colloquial origin.
items.cn: 「交换」义发展出来，最初见于口语；旧词典长期把它标为俚语，可见其口头来源。

items.en: The noun use (an act of exchange) becomes established, and the word spreads from speech into general written use.
items.cn: 名词用法（一次交换）确立下来，这个词从口语进入一般书面语。

items.en: Swap extends to information, duties, plans, and finance (currency swaps, interest rate swaps), while older strike senses survive only in dialects.
items.cn: swap 延伸到信息、班次、计划和金融领域（货币互换、利率掉期）；旧的「击打」义只残留在方言里。

items.en: The deeper origin is uncertain. Swap may be imitative of a swishing or striking sound; a link to the verb swerve or to low German words of similar meaning is sometimes suggested but not proven.
items.cn: 更深的来源不确定。一般认为 swap 可能是模拟挥击声的拟声词；有学者把它与 swerve 或低地德语中意义相近的词相联系，但均无确证。

note.en: Words that look or sound like swap, and words that live nearby in the field of exchanging.
note.cn: 与 swap 拼写或发音相近的词，以及与「交换」义场相邻的词。

entries.definition: an area of soft, wet land; to flood or overwhelm
entries.definitionCN: 沼泽；淹没，使应接不暇。只是比 swap 多一个字母 p，词义完全不同，属拼写相近但词源无关

entries.definition: to hit sharply, especially an insect
entries.definitionCN: 猛击、拍打（尤指拍苍蝇）。与 swap 拼写相近；有趣的是 swap 的旧义正是「击打」，但现代两词应分开理解

entries.definition: to move slowly from side to side; to influence someone
entries.definitionCN: 摇摆；动摇，左右某人。发音与拼写都接近 swap，词源上一般不认为同源

entries.definition: to give and receive things in return; the act of doing so
entries.definitionCN: 交换；兑换。较正式，涵盖 swap 的核心义，常用于货币、书信、礼品等场景

entries.definition: to buy, sell, or exchange goods or services
entries.definitionCN: 交易；做买卖；对换。强调买卖或职业性往来，swap 更口语、更侧重一来一往的对换

entries.definition: to exchange goods without using money
entries.definitionCN: 以物易物、实物交换。特指不动用货币的交换，语域比 swap 更正式、更古老

entries.definition: to exchange things or ideas with each other
entries.definitionCN: 互换、互相交流。强调双方对等地来去，多见于书面语和固定搭配

normalIntro.en: Five grounded hooks that tie swap to its spelling, sound, and real-life uses.
normalIntro.cn: 五条接地气的联想，把 swap 和它的拼写、读音与生活用法绑在一起。

normal.en: swap sounds like 'swuap' — think of hands crossing in the air as two people hand things over at the same moment.
normal.cn: swap 读起来像「斯握铺」——想象两个人同时递东西，两只手在空中交叉而过。

normal.en: SW-A-P: Students Will Always Pass things around — that passing is swapping.
normal.cn: S-W-A-P 可记为「Students Will Always Pass」——学生总在传东西，传着传着就是交换。

normal.en: swap and swamp differ by one letter: you swap cards, but you get swamped with homework.
normal.cn: swap 与 swamp 只差一个字母：换卡片用 swap，作业多到「被淹」（应接不暇）用 swamp。

normal.en: In finance you will meet currency swap — banks literally handing money streams back and forth.
normal.cn: 金融里会遇到 currency swap（货币互换）——银行把两股资金流你来我往地递来递去。

normal.en: swap meet is a market where everything is obtained by swapping, not buying.
normal.cn: swap meet 是「以物换物的集市」，一切靠交换而非购买。

abstract.en: Picture a revolving door: two people enter from opposite sides and exit with each other's place.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇旋转门：两人从相对的门进，出来时彼此站到了对方原来的位置。

abstract.en: Picture two dancers changing partners in mid-song without missing a beat.
abstract.cn: 想象两位舞者在乐曲中途互换舞伴，节奏丝毫不乱。

abstract.en: Picture two cups on a table being slid across each other's tracks until they sit where the other stood.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上两只杯子被推着划过对方的轨迹，最后各坐在对方原来的位置上。

examples.en: The two neighbours swap vegetables from their gardens every week.
examples.cn: 两位邻居每周互换自家菜园里的蔬菜。

examples.en: He swapped his old laptop for a second-hand bike.
examples.cn: 他用自己的旧笔记本电脑换了一辆二手自行车。

examples.en: The students swapped email addresses before the summer break.
examples.cn: 学生们在暑假前互留了电子邮箱。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯握铺」——两人各自握着东西，摊开手掌互铺到对方掌中，东西就换过去了。

root: swap 是英语本土词，无拉丁词根可依。一般认为与中世纪英语 swappen（挥击、摆动）同源，可能属拟声词；其「交换」义由「一来一往的动作」引申而来，深层来源不确定，不作强行构词解释。

sensesIntro.en: From physically exchanging objects, swap spreads to replacing things, trading words, duties, plans, and finally streams of money in finance.
sensesIntro.cn: swap 从实物的互换出发，扩展到替换物品、交流话语、对调班次、改换计划，最后落到金融资金的互换。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands passing in opposite directions, each leaving something behind and taking something away
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手朝相反方向递来递去，各自放下一样、带走一样

branches.en: the basic trade of physical objects
branches.cn: 实物对换：卡片、蔬菜、礼物

branches.en: what one side keeps gets replaced or the plan changes
branches.cn: 换位带来的替换与改换：换轮胎、改计划

branches.en: words and ideas moving back and forth
branches.cn: 话语的往来：交流观点、聊天

branches.en: positions and duties literally trading places
branches.cn: 班次与位置的对调：换班、对调课桌

branches.en: the act, its result, and the formal financial extension
branches.cn: 名词化与术语化：一笔交易、换来的东西、金融互换

intro.en: Swap has no classical prefix or suffix, but its family, derivatives, and fixed phrases show how a native monosyllable builds new uses.
intro.cn: swap 没有古典前缀或后缀，但它的词族、派生词与固定搭配展示了本土单音节词如何长出新用法。

latinIntro.en: Swap is not of Latin origin, so this section instead lists fixed phrases and near relatives that are often confused with it.
latinIntro.cn: swap 并非源自拉丁语，这里列出常与之混淆的固定搭配和近亲词。

items.meaningCN: swap 的过去式与过去分词，词尾 p 双写
swap 的现在分词，词尾 p 双写

items.meaning: third person singular verb or plural noun
items.meaningCN: 动词三单，或名词复数「多次交换」
items.example: She swaps shifts once a month.
a keen swapper of old records

items.meaningCN: 旧货交换集市（美式英语）
items.example: We found a radio at the swap meet.
items.exampleCN: 我们在跳蚤交换集市淘到一台收音机。

items.example: The two players swapped over at half-time.
items.exampleCN: 两名球员在中场时对调了位置。

items.meaning: to swap the positions of things
items.meaningCN: 把…的位置对调（英式用法）
items.example: Swap the chairs round a bit.

items.exampleCN: 一份两年期货币互换协议

items.meaningCN: swap 的英式变体拼写，义同 swap

definition_zh: 音乐专辑；相册；集邮册；签名纪念册；（古罗马）白色公告板
definition_en: a collection of recorded songs issued together, a book for keeping photographs, stamps or signatures, or the whitened board on which public notices were written in ancient Rome
core_image: 一本硬壳大书摊在膝上，纸页里贴着一排排小方片
scene: 客厅的矮柜里躺着一本硬壳大书，翻开是婚礼那天的照片，边角已经微微发黄。 She opened the album and found a photograph of her grandmother at twenty.
sceneCN: 这里 album 是「相册」（第 2 个义项：收集照片的册子）；句意为她翻开相册，找到一张祖母二十岁时的照片。画面里是矮柜、硬壳书与泛黄的照片。

pos.zh: 名词：音乐专辑；相册；集邮册；签名纪念册；古罗马公告板

derivatives.zh: 由前缀 mini- 与 album 组合而成，义为「迷你专辑」，指曲目较少、时长较短的发行形式
由 album 与 -oriented 组合而成，义为「以专辑为导向的」，多用于描述电台的编排格式

senses.title: A collection of recorded songs
senses.titleCN: 音乐专辑：成套发行的录音作品
senses.definition: a set of recorded songs or pieces released together as one work, on disc, tape or in digital form
senses.definitionCN: 作为一件作品成套发行的录音歌曲或乐曲，载体可以是唱片、磁带或数字文件
senses.example: Their second album sold a million copies in a month.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的第二张专辑一个月内卖出一百万张。
senses.why: Early records were sold in a book-like sleeve holding several discs, so the container's name moved onto the collection of songs inside it.
senses.whyCN: 早期的唱片装在一个像书一样、能装几张唱片的封套里，于是容器的名字转移到了里面那一组歌曲上。

senses.title: A book of photographs
senses.definition: a book with blank pages or pockets in which photographs are kept
senses.definitionCN: 有空白页或插袋、用来存放照片的册子
senses.example: The wedding album sat on the shelf for years without being opened.
senses.exampleCN: 那本婚礼相册在书架上放了好几年都没被翻开。
senses.why: Album first meant a blank surface for writing, and photographs are simply what people began pasting onto that blank surface.
senses.whyCN: album 最初指可供书写的空白表面，而照片不过是人们后来贴到这个空白表面上的东西。

senses.title: A book for stamps and clippings
senses.titleCN: 集邮册：贴存邮票与剪报的册子
senses.definition: a book with pages for mounting stamps, postcards, newspaper cuttings or other small flat items
senses.definitionCN: 页面可固定邮票、明信片、剪报或其他小件平面收藏品的册子
senses.example: He pasted every foreign stamp into a green album.
senses.exampleCN: 他把每一枚外国邮票都贴进一本绿色集邮册。
senses.why: The same blank book serves any small flat treasure, so stamps and clippings simply repeat the collecting gesture that photographs had already taught.
senses.whyCN: 同一本空白册子可以服务任何小件平面收藏品，于是邮票与剪报只是重复照片已经教会人们的那个「收集」动作。

senses.title: A book of signatures and memories
senses.titleCN: 签名纪念册：留字留念的册子
senses.definition: a book in which friends, guests or classmates write their names, wishes or short messages as a keepsake
senses.definitionCN: 请朋友、来客或同学写下姓名、祝愿或短句以作留念的册子
senses.example: Her classmates filled an album with wishes before she moved away.
senses.exampleCN: 她搬走之前，同学们在一本纪念册里写满了祝福。
senses.why: This is the oldest modern use: a blank book passed from hand to hand, so that the writing itself becomes the collection.
senses.whyCN: 这是这本书最早的现代用法：一本空白册子在人们手中传递，写下的字本身就成了被收藏的内容。

senses.title: The whitened notice board of Rome
senses.titleCN: 古罗马白色公告板：张贴公告的涂白木板
senses.definition: in ancient Rome, a board whitened with gypsum on which public notices, lists and announcements were written
senses.definitionCN: 古罗马用石膏涂白的木板，上面书写公告、名单与通告
senses.example: In Rome a notice of the games was painted on an album in the forum.
senses.exampleCN: 在罗马，竞技公告被写在广场的一块白色公告板上。
senses.why: The Latin word named a whitened board before it named a book, and this is the literal image from which every later collection sense grows.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁词先指涂白的木板，后指册子；正是这块板子的具体形象，长出了后来所有的「收集」义。

intro.en: Album comes straight from Latin, where it began as a whitened board and ended as a blank book.
intro.cn: album 直接来自拉丁语，在那里它先是一块涂白的木板，后来才成为空白册子。

items.en: Albus was the adjective for white or pale; it is the colour word behind the whole family, including albedo and albino.
items.cn: albus 是表示「白色、苍白」的形容词，是 albedo、albino 等一整族词背后的颜色词。

items.en: The neuter noun album meant a white tablet or board, especially one whitened with gypsum for public notices and lists.
items.cn: 中性名词 album 指白色的板或牌，尤指用石膏涂白、供书写公告与名单的木板。

items.en: Medieval Latin extended album from the board to the written list itself, and then to a blank book or register kept for entries.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语把 album 从木板扩展到写在上面的名单，再扩展到供人题写的空白册子或登记簿。

items.en: English album is recorded in the seventeenth century for a blank book in which friends wrote names and verses; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语 album 在十七世纪有记录，指供朋友写下姓名与赠言的空白册子；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Photograph and stamp albums belong to the nineteenth century; the recorded-music album grew out of book-like record sleeves in the twentieth century.
items.cn: 照片相册与集邮册属于十九世纪；唱片专辑则从二十世纪那种像书一样的唱片封套中发展出来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same Latin colour root albus; the near-meaning group gathers other kinds of collected works and books.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁颜色词根 albus 的一族词；近义组收其他类型的作品合集与册子。

entries.definition: The proportion of light a surface reflects; a scientific word built on Latin albus, white.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「反照率、反射率」，指表面反射光的比例；由拉丁语 albus「白」构成。

entries.definition: A person or animal born with no pigment in skin, hair or eyes; formed from the same white root.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「白化病患者、白化动物」，指出生时皮肤、毛发或眼睛缺少色素者；同出「白」这一词根。

entries.definition: The white of an egg; the Latin noun albumen also meant egg white, from albus.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「蛋白、蛋清」；拉丁语 albumen 本也指蛋清，源自 albus。

entries.definition: A white linen robe worn by priests; a church word from the Latin adjective for white.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「白麻布长袍」，是神职人员穿的礼服；来自拉丁语表示白色的形容词。

entries.definition: A collection of pieces gathered from various sources into one work.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「合集、汇编」，指从不同来源收集作品编成一册或一张。

entries.definition: A book of blank pages for pasting in photographs, cuttings and small keepsakes.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「剪贴簿」，指空白页可粘贴照片、剪报与小纪念品的册子。

entries.definition: A published collection of poems or stories by different writers.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「选集、诗文集」，指把不同作者的诗或小说编在一起出版的书。

entries.definition: A flat case, or the set of works it holds, used to show an artist's or designer's output.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「作品集、画夹」，指装作品的扁平夹子或其中展示艺术家成果的一组作品。

entries.definition: A disc carrying recorded sound; the physical object an album is played from.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「唱片」，指承载录音的圆盘，即播放专辑所用的实物。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin root albus, the board-to-book history, and the phrases album appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的拉丁词根 albus、从木板到册子的词义史，以及 album 实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Albus means white: the first album was a board whitened with gypsum so that notices would stand out.
normal.cn: albus 意为白色：最早的 album 是一块用石膏涂白的木板，好让公告更醒目。

normal.en: The word moved from board to list to blank book, which is why a photo album and a stamp album feel like the same object.
normal.cn: 这个词从木板走到名单，再走到空白册子，所以相册与集邮册感觉是同一种东西。

normal.en: Albedo, albino and albumen all keep the white idea, though their meanings moved far from paper.
normal.cn: albedo、albino、albumen 都保留了「白」的观念，尽管词义已经远离纸张。

normal.en: A studio album is recorded in a studio; a debut album is the first one a band releases.
normal.cn: studio album 是在录音室录的专辑；debut album 是乐队发行的第一张。

normal.en: The album cover is the book cover of this modern book of songs.
normal.cn: album cover 就是这本现代「歌本」的封面。

abstract.en: Picture a white board in a Roman square, then the same white surface bound into pages.
abstract.cn: 想象罗马广场上的一块白板，再想象同一片白色被装订成页。

abstract.en: The pages can hold photographs, stamps, signatures or songs; the container stays, the contents change.
abstract.cn: 这些页面可以装照片、邮票、签名或歌曲；容器不变，内容不断更换。

abstract.en: An album is an argument that separate small things belong together.
abstract.cn: album 本身就是一个主张：一件件小东西应当被放在一起。

examples.en: Their second album sold a million copies.
examples.cn: 他们的第二张专辑卖出了一百万张。

examples.en: She keeps every holiday photo in a thick album.
examples.cn: 她把每张假日照片都收在一本厚相册里。

examples.en: The band is recording a new album in London.
examples.cn: 乐队正在伦敦录制一张新专辑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿尔本」——阿尔白白的，本子也白白的：先贴公告，再贴照片与歌。

root: album 直接借自拉丁语 album，本义是「涂白的板」，来自形容词 albus「白色」。古罗马人把公告写在涂了石膏的白板上，中世纪拉丁语再由「白板上的名单」引申为空白登记册，英语十七世纪用它指题字留念的册子，十九世纪起指相册与集邮册，二十世纪又指唱片专辑。

sensesIntro.en: All five senses are the same blank surface: a whitened board for notices, then a blank book for signatures, photographs, stamps, and finally a sleeve for songs.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项都是同一片空白表面：先是贴公告的白板，再是题字、贴照片、贴邮票的空白册子，最后是装歌曲的封套。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white board waits for writing, and later the same white surface is bound into pages.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块白板等着被书写，后来同一片白色被装订成了书页。

branches.en: THE SONGS: a book-like sleeve holds discs, and its name passes to the songs inside.
branches.cn: 歌曲线：像书一样的封套装着唱片，名字便转到了里面的歌曲上。

branches.en: THE PHOTOGRAPHS: the blank page becomes a place to keep images.
branches.cn: 照片线：空白页面成了保存影像的地方。

branches.en: THE STAMPS: any small flat treasure can be pasted onto the same page.
branches.cn: 邮票线：任何小件平面收藏品都能贴到同样的页面上。

branches.en: THE SIGNATURES: friends write on the blank page, and the writing itself is the collection.
branches.cn: 签名线：朋友在空白页上写字，写下的字本身就是收藏。

branches.en: THE BOARD: the Roman notice board is the literal white surface behind every later sense.
branches.cn: 木板线：古罗马的公告板是后来所有义项背后那片具体的白色表面。

intro.en: Album is a Latin noun with a Latin adjective inside it; English adds combining forms and suffixes to build new words around it.
intro.cn: album 是一个内含拉丁形容词的拉丁名词；英语再用组合形式与后缀在它周围造新词。

latinIntro.en: Albus, album, albumen and albedo are all recorded Latin forms, so nothing in this family needs to be reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: albus、album、albumen 与 albedo 都是有记录的拉丁语形式，这一族词无需重构。

items.example: Albus is the colour word inside album.
items.exampleCN: albus 是 album 里面的那个颜色词。

items.example: The root appears in albino and albedo.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根出现在 albino 与 albedo 里。

items.example: The Latin noun is the direct source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词是英语词的直接来源。

items.example: It marks the gender of Latin album.
items.exampleCN: 它标出拉丁语 album 的性。

items.meaningCN: 构成 albumen 这类名词的词尾

latinEntries.meaning: a white board for notices; a register

derivatives.zh: 由前缀 mini- 与 album 组合而成，义为「迷你专辑」
由 album 与 -oriented 组合而成，义为「以专辑为导向的」

definition_zh: 意识；知觉；觉悟
definition_en: the state of being awake and able to think, or awareness of a shared issue
core_image: 麻醉退去，天花板的灯光一点点变清晰
scene: 麻醉慢慢退去，病人终于认出病房里的窗帘。 He lost consciousness for a few seconds.
sceneCN: 这里 consciousness 指「知觉」（第 2 个义项：清醒并感知外界的状态）；句意是他有几秒钟失去了知觉。

senses.title: Being awake
senses.definition: the state of being awake and able to think and feel
senses.definitionCN: 醒着并能思考、感受的状态
senses.example: He slowly regained consciousness in the ambulance.
senses.exampleCN: 他在救护车里慢慢恢复了知觉。
senses.why: The inner light goes out, and then it comes back.
senses.whyCN: 心里的灯先熄灭，然后又亮起来。

senses.title: Awareness of something
senses.definition: the fact of noticing or caring about an issue
senses.definitionCN: 对某个问题的注意与关心
senses.example: There is growing consciousness of water waste.
senses.exampleCN: 人们对水资源浪费的意识正在增强。
senses.why: A problem becomes real to a person only when it is noticed.
senses.whyCN: 一个问题被人注意到，才对这个人变得真实。

senses.title: A shared mindset
senses.definition: the shared beliefs and feelings of a group
senses.definitionCN: 一个群体共有的信念与感受
senses.example: The movement changed public consciousness.
senses.exampleCN: 这场运动改变了公众意识。
senses.why: Many private minds can settle into one common weather.
senses.whyCN: 许多私人的心思，可以沉淀成一种共同的天气。

intro.en: Consciousness is conscious plus the noun ending -ness, built on Latin conscius, knowing with oneself.
intro.cn: consciousness 是 conscious 加名词词尾 -ness，源头是拉丁语 conscius，意为与自己共知。

items.en: Scire meant to know, and conscius meant sharing knowledge.
items.cn: scire 意为知道，conscius 意为共享知识。

items.en: The noun conscientia named inward knowledge of oneself.
items.cn: 名词 conscientia 指对自身的内部知识。

items.en: English formed consciousness from conscious and -ness.
items.cn: 英语用 conscious 加 -ness 造出 consciousness。

items.en: Psychology made it the name of the waking mind.
items.cn: 心理学把它定为清醒心智的名称。

items.en: It now also means a group's shared awareness of an issue.
items.cn: 如今它也指一个群体对某个问题的共同意识。

note.en: The look-alike group is the conscience family, and the meaning group names other states of noticing.
note.cn: 形近组是 conscience 家族，近义组列出其他表示察觉状态的词。

entries.definition: the inner sense of right and wrong
entries.definitionCN: 良心；是非感

entries.definition: awake and aware
entries.definitionCN: 清醒而有察觉的

entries.definition: careful to do what is right
entries.definitionCN: 认真的；尽责的

entries.definition: knowledge that something exists
entries.definitionCN: 对某事物存在的知晓

entries.definition: the state of being quick to notice
entries.definitionCN: 警觉；机敏

entries.definition: the part of a person that thinks and feels
entries.definitionCN: 心智；头脑

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a waking patient, then move to a problem people begin to see and to a mood shared by a crowd.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从醒来的病人开始，再到人们开始看见的问题，最后到人群共有的情绪。

normal.en: Conscious plus -ness is simply the state of being conscious.
normal.cn: conscious 加 -ness，就是处于有意识状态。

normal.en: Losing consciousness is a light going out; regaining it is the switch clicking back.
normal.cn: 失去知觉是灯灭了，恢复知觉是开关又咔哒一声。

normal.en: Social consciousness begins when a private worry becomes a public word.
normal.cn: 社会意识始于私人的担忧变成一个公开的词。

normal.en: A raised consciousness is a raised hand.
normal.cn: 被唤醒的觉悟，就是一只举起来的手。

normal.en: The word sounds like conscience but points at the light, not the judge.
normal.cn: 这个词听起来像 conscience，但它指那盏灯，而不是法官。

abstract.en: Picture a white ceiling slowly coming into focus.
abstract.cn: 想象白色的天花板慢慢变清晰。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd all turning to look at one sign.
abstract.cn: 想象一群人同时转头看同一块牌子。

abstract.en: Picture a hand held up in a dark hall.
abstract.cn: 想象黑暗大厅里举起的一只手。

examples.en: The blow did not cost him consciousness.
examples.cn: 那一击没有让他失去知觉。

examples.en: Environmental consciousness has grown in the past decade.
examples.cn: 环保意识在过去十年里增强了。

examples.en: She spoke with a new consciousness of her own rights.
examples.cn: 她带着对自身权利的新觉悟说话。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consciousness 记成 conscious（有意识的）加 ness（状态）：灯亮着的那种状态，就是意识。

root: 由拉丁语 conscius（com 与 + scire 知道）经 conscious 加 -ness 构成，指清醒感知的状态，后扩展为群体觉悟。

sensesIntro.en: From the light of a waking mind, to noticing a problem, and finally to a belief shared by many.
sensesIntro.cn: 从清醒心智的光，到注意到某个问题，最后到许多人共有的信念。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a light that can go out and come back on.
core.cn: 核心意象：一盏会熄灭也会重新亮起的灯。

branches.en: The first sense is the bare state of being awake.
branches.cn: 第一个义项就是醒着这一基本状态。

branches.en: The second sense adds an object: something is noticed.
branches.cn: 第二个义项加上了对象：某件事被注意到。

branches.en: The third sense spreads that noticing across a whole group.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把这种注意扩展到整个群体。

branches.en: Being awake is the ground on which any noticing stands.
branches.cn: 醒着，是任何察觉得以成立的地面。

branches.en: One person's noticing becomes a group's consciousness when others agree.
branches.cn: 一个人的察觉，在别人认同后就成了群体的意识。

intro.en: Consciousness is conscious plus -ness, from Latin com-, with, and scire, to know.
intro.cn: consciousness 是 conscious 加 -ness，源自拉丁语 com-（与）与 scire（知道）。

latinIntro.en: The Latin know base sci- also appears in science, conscience and omniscient.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的知道词基 sci- 也出现在 science、conscience 与 omniscient 中。

items.exampleCN: 他在黎明时恢复了知觉。

items.example: She was conscious of the risk.
He consciously kept his voice low.
The image stayed in her subconscious.
items.exampleCN: 那个画面留在她的潜意识里。

items.meaning: the inner sense of right and wrong

items.exampleCN: 那个声音听起来无所不知。

definition_zh: 解释；理解；演绎；口译
definition_en: an explanation of what something means, a particular way of understanding it, or a performance that shows one's reading
core_image: 同一段旧文字，旁边密密麻麻写着不同颜色的批注，每一层都是一种读法
scene: 学生把同一行诗抄了三遍，每一遍旁边写下自己不同的想法。 Her interpretation of the contract was stricter than his.
sceneCN: 这里 interpretation 是「解释、理解」（第 1 个义项：对含义的说明），句意为她对合同的解释比他更严格。画面里的物件：诗稿、彩色批注、放大镜。

pos.zh: 名词：解释；理解；演绎；口译

collocations.phrase: a fresh interpretation of a play

derivatives.zh: 去后缀构成，义为「解释；口译」
由 interpret 加 -ive 构成，义为「解释性的」
由 interpret 加 -er 构成，义为「口译员」
加前缀 mis- 构成，义为「误解」

senses.title: An explanation offered
senses.definition: a statement that explains what something means or how it should be understood
senses.definitionCN: 说明某事物含义或应当如何理解的陈述
senses.example: The guide gave a short interpretation of each symbol.
senses.exampleCN: 讲解员对每个符号都作了简短解释。
senses.why: The Latin -atio turned the act of explaining into a thing you can hand to another.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 -atio 把「解释」这个动作变成可以递给别人的东西。

senses.title: A personal reading
senses.definition: the particular way a person understands a text, event, or action
senses.definitionCN: 某个人理解文本、事件或动作的特定方式
senses.example: Her interpretation of the results differed from the lab's.
senses.exampleCN: 她对结果的解读与实验室的不同。
senses.why: Once explanation is a thing, it can differ from person to person.
senses.whyCN: 解释一旦成了具体的东西，就可能因人而异。

senses.title: A performance
senses.definition: a way of performing a piece of music or drama that reveals the performer's understanding
senses.definitionCN: 体现表演者理解的演奏或戏剧呈现方式
senses.example: The director's interpretation set the play in a factory.
senses.exampleCN: 导演的演绎把这部戏搬进了一家工厂。
senses.why: Performance continued the older sense: the player interprets the work as a text.
senses.whyCN: 表演延续了旧义：演奏者把作品当文本去解释。

senses.title: Live translation
senses.definition: the act of translating speech from one language into another as it happens
senses.definitionCN: 在讲话进行的同时把话语译成另一种语言的活动
senses.example: Simultaneous interpretation requires intense concentration.
senses.exampleCN: 同声传译需要高度专注。
senses.why: The go-between sense of the base verb lives on in this technical noun.
senses.whyCN: 原动词的「中间人」义在这个专业名词里延续下来。

intro.en: Interpretation is the Latin noun of result built on interpretari, the work of a go-between.
intro.cn: interpretation 是建立在 interpretari（中间人的工作）之上的拉丁语结果名词。

items.en: Interpres named the person who carried meaning between parties.
items.cn: interpres 指在双方之间传递含义的人。

items.en: Interpretatio was the explaining that such a person produced.
items.cn: interpretatio 是这类人所做出的解释。

items.en: French interpretation kept the sense of expounding a text.
items.cn: 法语 interpretation 保留了阐述文本的意思。

items.en: The word entered English with law, scripture, and dreams.
items.cn: 这个词随法律、经文与解梦进入英语。

items.en: Modern usage adds performance and conference translation.
items.cn: 现代用法又添上表演与会议翻译。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the interpret- stem; the near-meaning group holds other names for an explanation.
note.cn: 形近组共用 interpret- 词干；近义组收其他表示「说明」的名词。

entries.definition: The verb of explaining or translating.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「解释；口译」。

entries.definition: The person doing it, not the result.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「口译员」，指人而非结果。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning explanatory.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「解释性的」。

entries.definition: The act of making something clear.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「说明」，强调说清楚。

entries.definition: One person's version of what a text means.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「解读」，偏个人理解。

entries.definition: One account of an event among several.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「一种说法」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks work best with the verb interpret, which the noun simply turns into a thing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子最好和动词 interpret 搭配，名词只是把它变成了一件东西。

normal.en: -ation turns the act into a product: interpret, interpretation.
normal.cn: -ation 把动作变成产物：interpret、interpretation。

normal.en: An interpretation is something you can write down and hand over.
normal.cn: 解释是能写下来、递出去的东西。

normal.en: Two people can hold two interpretations of one sentence.
normal.cn: 一句话可以有两个人各自的解释。

normal.en: Simultaneous interpretation happens in a glass booth.
normal.cn: 同声传译发生在玻璃隔间里。

normal.en: A director's interpretation changes what you see on stage.
normal.cn: 导演的演绎会改变你在台上看到的东西。

abstract.en: A text is a room; an interpretation is the furniture you bring in.
abstract.cn: 文本是一间房，解释是你搬进去的家具。

abstract.en: Every reading leaves fingerprints on the page.
abstract.cn: 每种读法都会在纸上留下指纹。

abstract.en: Meaning is not found; it is handed to you by a reader.
abstract.cn: 含义不是被找到的，是某个读者递给你的。

examples.en: The judge's interpretation of the rule surprised both sides.
examples.cn: 法官对规则的解释让双方都很意外。

examples.en: Her interpretation of the role was quieter than the usual one.
examples.cn: 她对这个角色的演绎比通常的更安静。

examples.en: Their interpretation of the data has been challenged.
examples.cn: 他们对数据的解读受到了质疑。

dict_mnemonic.text: interpret（解释）+ ation（结果）——解释出来的那套说法

root: 拉丁语 interpres「中间人」→ interpretari「解释」→ interpretatio「解释的产物」→ 古法语 → 英语 interpretation。同族有 interpret、interpreter、interpretive。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: an offered explanation, a personal reading, a staged performance, and live translation.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：给出的解释、个人的读法、舞台上的演绎，以及现场口译。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a page covered in coloured notes, each colour a different reader.
core.cn: 核心意象：一页纸上写满各色批注，每种颜色都是一位读者。

branches.en: THE NOTE: the explanation you can hand over.
branches.cn: 便条这条线：可以递出去的解释。

branches.en: THE GLASSES: the reader's own way of seeing.
branches.cn: 眼镜这条线：读者自己的看法。

branches.en: THE STAGE: a work shown through one mind.
branches.cn: 舞台这条线：经由一个人头脑呈现的作品。

branches.en: THE BOOTH: speech carried across languages.
branches.cn: 隔间这条线：话语被搬过语言边界。

branches.en: THE EAR: both senses begin with hearing a meaning first.
branches.cn: 耳朵线：两个义项都先要听见一种含义。

intro.en: Interpretation is interpret plus the Latin noun ending -ation, which names an act or its result.
intro.cn: interpretation 是 interpret 加拉丁名词词尾 -ation，表示行为或其结果。

latinIntro.en: Latin interpretatio and interpretari are recorded forms of this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interpretatio 与 interpretari 都是这一族的记载形式。

items.example: The oldest form in the family.
items.exampleCN: 这一族中最古老的形式。

items.example: The verb supplies the whole stem.
items.exampleCN: 整个词干来自这个动词。

items.example: It turns the verb into a noun.
It forms interpreter in place of the result.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 interpreter，指人而非结果。

items.example: It is the shorter form of -ation in translation.
items.exampleCN: 它是 translation 中 -ation 的短形。

definition_zh: 线索；提示；头绪
definition_en: a fact or object that helps to solve a problem or a mystery, or an understanding of a situation
core_image: 桌上摊开的纸片被一根线串起来
scene: 侦探把桌上的纸片一张张排开，寻找能串起来的线索。 A single footprint gave the police their first clue.
sceneCN: 这里 clue 指「线索」（第 1 个义项：有助于解开谜团的事实或物件）；句意是一个脚印给了警方第一条线索。

senses.title: A fact that helps solve a mystery
senses.definition: a piece of evidence that points towards the answer
senses.definitionCN: 指向答案的一件证据
senses.example: The note was the only clue to his whereabouts.
senses.exampleCN: 那张字条是唯一能说明他去向的线索。
senses.why: A clue was a ball of thread that guided a hero out of a maze, so it still means something that guides.
senses.whyCN: clue 原是一团把英雄引出迷宫的线，因此至今指能引路的东西。

senses.title: Knowledge of a situation
senses.definition: an idea or understanding of what is happening
senses.definitionCN: 对正在发生之事的一点概念或了解
senses.example: She had no clue how the machine worked.
senses.exampleCN: 她对这台机器怎么运作毫无头绪。
senses.why: If a thread shows the way, then having a clue means knowing which way to go.
senses.whyCN: 如果线能指路，那么有线索就意味着知道往哪走。

intro.en: Clue comes from an old word for a ball of thread, the kind a hero used to find his way out.
intro.cn: clue 出自表示线团的古词，正是英雄用来找路走出迷宫的那种线。

items.en: Cliwen meant a ball of thread or yarn.
items.cn: cliwen 指一团线或纱。

items.en: A clew of thread guided a person through a maze in an old story.
items.cn: 在古老故事里，一团线引导人走出迷宫。

items.en: The spelling clue appeared beside the older clew.
items.cn: 拼写 clue 与较早的 clew 并行出现。

items.en: The meaning widened from thread to any guiding fact.
items.cn: 含义从线扩展到任何起引导作用的事实。

items.en: A clue is now a fact that helps solve a problem.
items.cn: clue 如今指有助于解决问题的线索。

note.en: The look-alike group holds short words with the same sound or shape, while the meaning group names signs and evidence.
note.cn: 形近组收同音或形近的短词，近义组列出迹象与证据。

entries.definition: a thick liquid used to stick things together
entries.definitionCN: 用来粘合东西的黏稠液体

entries.definition: having the colour of a clear sky
entries.definitionCN: 具有晴空那种颜色的

entries.definition: a signal that tells someone to begin
entries.definitionCN: 提示某人开始的信号

entries.definition: a small piece of advice that helps you guess
entries.definitionCN: 帮助猜测的一点点提示

entries.definition: something that shows that a fact exists
entries.definitionCN: 显示某种事实存在的事物

entries.definition: facts that support a belief or a case
entries.definitionCN: 支持某种看法或案件的事实

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the ball of thread, the maze and the moment of having no idea.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从线团、迷宫和毫无头绪的那一刻入手。

normal.en: Clue and clew are the same word; clew is the old spelling for a ball of thread.
normal.cn: clue 与 clew 本是同一个词，clew 是线团的旧拼法。

normal.en: Clue and glue differ by one letter: glue sticks, a clue leads.
normal.cn: clue 与 glue 只差一个字母：胶水粘住，线索引路。

normal.en: A detective follows a clue the way a hero follows a thread.
normal.cn: 侦探顺线索查案，就像英雄顺线而行。

normal.en: No clue means the thread has slipped out of your hand.
normal.cn: no clue 就是线从手里滑走了。

normal.en: Clueless adds -less, so the person has no guiding thread at all.
normal.cn: clueless 加了 -less，指人一点引路的线都没有。

abstract.en: Picture a red thread running along a stone floor in the dark.
abstract.cn: 想象黑暗中一条红线沿着石地延伸。

abstract.en: Picture a footprint in soft mud beside a broken gate.
abstract.cn: 想象破门旁软泥里的一枚脚印。

abstract.en: Picture a person shrugging in front of a confusing map.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人面对看不懂的地图耸了耸肩。

examples.en: The muddy shoe left a clue beside the door.
examples.cn: 那只沾泥的鞋在门边留下了线索。

examples.en: Nobody had a clue what the letter meant.
examples.cn: 没人知道那封信是什么意思。

examples.en: Her calm reply gave him a clue about her mood.
examples.cn: 她平静的回答让他对她的情绪有了点头绪。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 clue 记成「一团线」：握住线头，顺着走，就能走出迷雾。

root: 源自古英语 cliwen（线团），旧拼 clew，因线团引路的故事引申为线索。

sensesIntro.en: From a thread that leads the way to any fact that leads the mind.
sensesIntro.cn: 从引路的线，到任何能引出思路的事实。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thread held in the hand, running into the dark.
core.cn: 核心意象：手里握着一根线，伸进黑暗里。

branches.en: The evidence sense keeps the picture of a guiding thread.
branches.cn: 证据义保留了引路线索的画面。

branches.en: Having a clue means holding the thread of a situation.
branches.cn: 有头绪就意味着握着局势的线头。

branches.en: Both senses describe something that reduces confusion.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述能减少困惑的东西。

branches.en: A clue points outward, to a fact in the world.
branches.cn: 线索向外指，指向世间的一件事实。

branches.en: The same thread can lead to a suspect or to understanding.
branches.cn: 同一根线既能引向嫌疑人，也能引向理解。

intro.en: The stem keeps the old thread word alive and adds modern compounds.
intro.cn: 这个词干保住了古老的线团词，并构成现代复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is the Old English noun cliwen.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是古英语名词 cliwen。

items.meaning: more than one piece of evidence
items.exampleCN: 这个房间提供了好几条线索。

items.example: He was clueless about the new rules.

items.exampleCN: 她的一无所知让团队吃惊。

items.example: He is clued-up on local politics.

items.meaning: a ball of thread, the older form of clue
items.example: Clew still appears in sailing texts.
items.exampleCN: clew 仍出现在航海文本中。

items.meaning: the activity of searching for clues
built on hints rather than direct proof
items.example: The game is a clue-based puzzle.
items.exampleCN: 这个游戏是基于线索的解谜。

items.example: She made a few clue-giving remarks.
items.exampleCN: 她说了几句提示性的话。

definition_zh: 紧急的；急迫的；迫切的；亟待处理的
definition_en: needing immediate attention or action
core_image: 一封信被封上红色加急标签，快递员一路按着喇叭冲进院子
scene: 深夜办公室的灯还亮着，桌上摊着一份标红的文件，秘书站在门口不知该不该打断会议。 The doctor received an urgent call and left at once.
sceneCN: 这里 urgent 是「紧急的」（第 1 个义项：需要立刻处理）；句意为医生接到一个紧急电话，立刻离开了。红色加急标签催促着人马上动手，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 形容词：紧急的、急迫的；迫切的；催得很急的

derivatives.zh: 名词，义为「紧迫、紧急」，加 -cy 构成
加 -ly 构成，义为「紧急地、迫切地」
动词，义为「催促、力劝」，是 urgent 的同源动词
名词，义为「催促、劝告」，是 urge 的动名词

senses.title: Needing quick action
senses.titleCN: 急需处理：必须马上动手
senses.definition: requiring immediate attention or action
senses.definitionCN: 需要立刻关注或采取行动
senses.example: The doctor received an urgent call and left at once.
senses.exampleCN: 医生接到一个紧急电话，立刻离开了。
senses.why: Latin urgere means to press or push; something urgent presses on you until you move.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 urgere 意为「压、推」；紧急之事就是这样一直压着你，直到你动起来。

senses.title: Sounding insistent
senses.titleCN: 催促的语气：说得急而不容拖延
senses.definition: expressed with insistence, asking someone to act at once
senses.definitionCN: 带着不容拖延的语气，要求别人立即行事
senses.example: Her letter was an urgent plea for help.
senses.exampleCN: 她的信是一封急切的求助呼吁。
senses.why: The pressure of the verb passes into the voice: the words themselves push the reader.
senses.whyCN: 动词的压迫感进入声音：字句本身在推着读者走。

senses.title: A pressing need
senses.definition: a strong and immediate need for something
senses.definitionCN: 对某物强烈而即时的需求
senses.example: The village is in urgent need of clean water.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村庄急需干净的水。
senses.why: A need that presses is one that cannot wait for next month.
senses.whyCN: 会「压迫」的需求，就是等不到下个月的那种需求。

senses.title: Important and pressing
senses.titleCN: 重要而急迫：事情本身分量重
senses.definition: important enough that delay would cause harm
senses.definitionCN: 重要到一旦拖延就会造成损害
senses.example: Finding shelter became urgent as the storm grew.
senses.exampleCN: 随着暴风雨加剧，找到避难所变得紧迫起来。
senses.why: Urgency here is not noise but weight: the matter presses because the cost of delay is high.
senses.whyCN: 这里的紧迫不是喧闹而是分量：拖延代价高，事情才压得紧。

intro.en: Urgent comes from the Latin verb urgere, to press or drive on, through its present participle urgens.
intro.cn: urgent 来自拉丁语动词 urgere「压、驱赶」，取其现在分词 urgens。

items.en: The verb urgere meant to push, press or drive something forward.
items.cn: 动词 urgere 意为推、压、把某物向前赶。

items.en: Its present participle urgens described whatever is pressing at this very moment.
items.cn: 它的现在分词 urgens 描述此刻正在施压的东西。

items.en: Old French took the participle as urgent, still carrying the pressure of the Latin verb.
items.cn: 古法语把这一分词借作 urgent，仍带着拉丁动词的压迫感。

items.en: English borrowed urgent in the fifteenth century for matters that would not wait.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪借入 urgent，用来指不容等待的事情。

items.en: Modern usage pairs it with need, action and care, all situations where delay costs something.
items.cn: 现代用法把它和 need、action、care 搭配，都是拖延会付出代价的情形。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the urg- stem and its Latin family; the near-meaning group holds synonyms about haste and necessity.
note.cn: 形近组沿 urg- 词干及其拉丁词族；近义组收表示急切与必要的近义词。

entries.definition: To press someone to act; the verb behind urgent.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「催促、力劝」，是 urgent 背后的动词。

entries.definition: The quality of being urgent; the noun built on it.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「紧迫性」，由 urgent 构成。

entries.definition: In an urgent manner; the adverb.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「紧急地」，是它的副词形式。

entries.definition: Medical help for problems that cannot wait.
entries.definitionCN: 名词短语，义为「急诊服务」，指不能等待的医疗。

entries.definition: Needing action now; literally weighing on you.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「紧迫的」，字面上就是压在你身上。

entries.definition: Absolutely necessary; stronger and more formal.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「必须的」，更正式也更绝对。

entries.definition: So important that failure would be serious.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「关键的、危急的」，失败后果严重。

entries.definition: Happening without delay, without the sense of pressure.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「立即的」，但不含压力感。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the pressing image of the Latin verb and real collocations such as urgent need.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用拉丁动词的「压」意象，以及 urgent need 这类真实搭配。

normal.en: Urgent shares a root with urge: both push somebody to move.
normal.cn: urgent 与 urge 同根，都在推动某人行动。

normal.en: An urgent call is one you answer before you finish your tea.
normal.cn: 紧急电话就是茶没喝完就得接的那种电话。

normal.en: In urgent need means the need is pressing right now.
normal.cn: in urgent need 指此刻就急得压人。

normal.en: Urgent care is the clinic you go to when waiting is not an option.
normal.cn: urgent care 就是不能等时去的那种诊所。

normal.en: Mark urgent on an envelope and the postman hurries.
normal.cn: 在信封上写 urgent，邮差就会加快脚步。

abstract.en: The whole word is a hand on your back: urgency is pressure whose source you may not even see.
abstract.cn: 整个词就是一只推着你后背的手：紧迫感来自一种你甚至看不见的压力。

abstract.en: Something is urgent when the cost of waiting exceeds the cost of acting.
abstract.cn: 一件事之所以紧急，是因为等待的代价超过了行动的代价。

abstract.en: Urgency is a comparison in time, not a size: the small thing that must be done now outranks the big thing that can wait.
abstract.cn: 紧迫是时间上的比较而非体量：必须现在做的小事，压过可以等的大事。

examples.en: There is an urgent need for more nurses in the region.
examples.cn: 该地区急需更多护士。

examples.en: He sent an urgent message asking us to postpone the meeting.
examples.cn: 他发来紧急消息，要求我们推迟会议。

examples.en: The repairs are urgent because the roof leaks badly.
examples.cn: 修理很紧急，因为屋顶漏得很厉害。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「饿真急」——饿了真急，得马上找饭吃：紧急的

root: 源自拉丁语动词 urgere「压、驱赶」的现在分词 urgens，经古法语 urgent 于十五世纪进入英语；同族词有 urge、urgency、urgently。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of urgent move from the call that must be answered to the need, the plea and the weight of the matter.
sensesIntro.cn: urgent 的四个义项从必须接的电话，走到需求、诉求与事情本身的分量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a red label on an envelope, and a hand pushing you towards the door.
core.cn: 核心意象：信封上的红色标签，以及一只把你推向门口的手。

branches.en: TIME LINE: the thing must be done at once.
branches.cn: 时间线：这件事必须立刻完成。

branches.en: VOICE LINE: the words themselves push the reader.
branches.cn: 声音线：字句本身在推动读者。

branches.en: NEED LINE: what is missing is missing badly.
branches.cn: 需求线：缺的东西缺得很厉害。

branches.en: WEIGHT LINE: delay would cause real harm.
branches.cn: 分量线：拖延会造成真实损害。

branches.en: CONTRAST: important can wait, urgent cannot.
branches.cn: 对照线：重要的可以等，紧急的不能等。

intro.en: Urgent is a Latin participle stripped of its ending and used as an English adjective.
intro.cn: urgent 是一个去掉词尾的拉丁分词，直接充当英语形容词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pieces are clear: the verb urgere and the participle ending -ens, -entis.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁构件很清楚：动词 urgere 与分词词尾 -ens、-entis。

items.example: It is the root of urgent.
It turns the verb into an adjective.
It forms insurgent from the same verb.
items.exampleCN: 它和同一动词构成 insurgent。

items.example: It forms surge from the same verb.
items.exampleCN: 它和同一动词构成 surge。

items.example: It shows the word in a fixed phrase.
items.exampleCN: 它展示了这个词的固定搭配。

definition_zh: 排除；不包括；把…拒之门外
definition_en: to keep someone or something out, or to leave them out
core_image: 名额已满后关上的门
scene: 因为名额有限，主办方不得不把一些申请者排除在外。 Because places were limited, the organizers had to exclude some applicants.
sceneCN: 这里 exclude 是「把…排除在外」（第 1 个义项：不让某人进入或参与）；句意：因为名额有限，主办方不得不把一些申请者排除在外。

senses.title: Keeping someone out
senses.definition: to stop someone from entering or joining
senses.definitionCN: 阻止某人进入或加入
senses.example: The club excluded women for years.
senses.exampleCN: 这家俱乐部多年来排斥女性。
senses.why: The word closes a door on someone.
senses.whyCN: 这个词对某人关上了门。

senses.title: Not including
senses.definition: to leave something out of a group or list
senses.definitionCN: 把某物从群体或清单中略去
senses.example: The price excludes delivery.
senses.exampleCN: 价格不含送货费。
senses.why: One item is kept outside the count.
senses.whyCN: 一项被留在计数之外。

senses.title: Ruling out
senses.definition: to decide that something is not possible
senses.definitionCN: 断定某事不可能
senses.example: We cannot exclude the possibility of rain.
senses.exampleCN: 我们不能排除下雨的可能。
senses.why: A possibility is shut out of the answer.
senses.whyCN: 一种可能被关在答案之外。

intro.en: Exclude comes from Latin excludere, to shut out.
intro.cn: exclude 源自拉丁语 excludere，意为关在外面。

items.en: Claudere means to close or shut.
items.cn: claudere 意为关闭。

items.en: Excludere joins ex-, out, with claudere.
items.cn: excludere 由 ex-（出）与 claudere 组成。

items.en: French exclure keeps the sense of shutting out.
items.cn: 法语 exclure 保留关在外面之意。

items.en: English exclude covers people, items and ideas.
items.cn: 英语 exclude 涵盖人、物品与想法。

items.en: Excluding tax becomes a set phrase.
items.cn: excluding tax 成为固定短语。

note.en: Exclude is the opposite of include.
note.cn: exclude 是 include 的反义词。

entries.definition: the act of excluding
entries.definitionCN: 排除

entries.definition: not shared with others
entries.definitionCN: 独有的

entries.definition: to take something in
entries.definitionCN: 包括

entries.definition: to stop someone entering
entries.definitionCN: 禁止进入

entries.definition: to leave something out
entries.definitionCN: 省略

entries.definition: to keep someone outside
entries.definitionCN: 把…关在外面

normalIntro.en: To exclude is to close the door on someone.
normalIntro.cn: exclude 就是对某人关上门。

normal.en: Exclude from means keep out of a group.
normal.cn: exclude from 意为不让进入某个群体。

normal.en: Exclude the possibility means rule it out.
normal.cn: exclude the possibility 意为排除这种可能。

normal.en: The price excludes delivery.
normal.cn: 价格不含送货费。

normal.en: Excluding tax means before tax is added.
normal.cn: excluding tax 意为未加税前。

normal.en: Exclusion is the noun from exclude.
normal.cn: exclusion 是 exclude 的名词。

abstract.en: Picture a door closing in front of someone.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门在某人面前关上。

abstract.en: Imagine one name crossed off a list.
abstract.cn: 想象清单上一个名字被划掉。

abstract.en: Think of a gate locked after the last guest.
abstract.cn: 想象最后一位客人之后大门上锁。

examples.en: The list excludes names with no address.
examples.cn: 这份清单排除了没有地址的名字。

examples.en: Nobody should be excluded because of age.
examples.cn: 任何人都不应因年龄被排斥。

examples.en: We cannot exclude a later change.
examples.cn: 我们不能排除以后会有变化。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ex（出）＋ clude（关）」——关在门外，就是排除。

root: 拉丁语 excludere（关在外面）＝ ex-（出）＋ claudere（关闭）→ exclude，核心义「把人或事物关在范围之外」。

sensesIntro.en: Exclude means to keep someone out, leave something out, or rule out a possibility.
sensesIntro.cn: exclude 意为把某人拒之门外、不包括某物，或排除某种可能。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door closed on someone.
core.cn: 核心意象：对某人关上的门。

branches.en: Keeping a person out is the main sense.
branches.cn: 把人挡在外面是主要义项。

branches.en: An item can be left out of a list.
branches.cn: 一项可以被从清单中略去。

branches.en: A possibility can be shut out of thought.
branches.cn: 一种可能可以被排除在考虑之外。

branches.en: People and items both stay outside.
branches.cn: 人与物品都被留在外面。

branches.en: Omitting a fact can rule out an option.
branches.cn: 略去一个事实可能排除一个选项。

intro.en: Exclude joins ex-, out, with Latin claudere, to close.
intro.cn: exclude 由 ex-（出）与拉丁语 claudere（关闭）组成。

latinIntro.en: Claudere also lies behind close and clause.
latinIntro.cn: claudere 也是 close 与 clause 的来源。

items.exampleCN: claudere 出现在 clause 中。
exclusive 意为把他人排除在外。

latinEntries.example: Excludere is the source of exclude.
latinEntries.exampleCN: excludere 是 exclude 的来源。

definition_zh: 然而；但是；鉴于（法律文件用语）
definition_en: used to contrast two facts, or to open formal legal statements
core_image: 天平两端各放一枚事实，两两相望
scene: 姐姐把房间收拾得干干净净，门铃响了也不动。 Her brother loves loud parties, whereas she prefers quiet evenings at home.
sceneCN: 这里 whereas 是连词「然而」（第 1 个义项：对比两件事）；句意是她哥哥喜欢热闹派对，而她偏爱家中安静的夜晚。

collocations.phrase: A is high whereas B is low
collocations.zh: A 高而 B 低（数据对比）

derivatives.zh: 基础词，义为「在哪里」，whereas 由 where + as 构成
近义连词，义为「然而；在……期间」

senses.title: In contrast to the first fact
senses.definition: used to compare two things that are different
senses.definitionCN: 用于比较两个不同的事物
senses.example: The north is mountainous, whereas the south is flat farmland.
senses.exampleCN: 北部多山，而南部是平坦的农田。
senses.why: Two facts stand on the two pans of a balance, seen at once.
senses.whyCN: 两个事实被放在天平两端，同时呈现。

senses.title: Opening formal legal documents
senses.definition: used at the start of legal contracts to state background facts
senses.definitionCN: 用于合同开篇陈述背景事实
senses.example: Whereas the parties agreed to cooperate, the contract was signed.
senses.exampleCN: 鉴于双方同意合作，合同得以签署。
senses.why: The weighing word becomes a solemn opener: each fact is laid on the record.
senses.whyCN: 权衡之词变成庄重的开场：每项事实依次入档。

senses.title: Introducing data comparison
senses.definition: used before statistics that differ from the first set
senses.definitionCN: 引出与前面数据不同的统计
senses.example: Sales rose by ten percent, whereas costs fell.
senses.exampleCN: 销售额上升百分之十，而成本下降了。
senses.why: Numbers on opposite pans make the balance visible at a glance.
senses.whyCN: 反向的数字让天平的倾斜一眼可见。

senses.title: Marking an opposite habit or trait
senses.definition: used to contrast habits, traits, or preferences
senses.definitionCN: 对比习惯、特质或偏好
senses.example: He saves every coin, whereas his sister spends freely.
senses.exampleCN: 他把每一枚硬币都存起来，而妹妹花钱大手大脚。
senses.why: Character differences are laid side by side like contrasting figures.
senses.whyCN: 性格差异像对比数字一样被并排放置。

senses.title: Introducing an exception
senses.definition: used to add a case that differs from the general rule
senses.definitionCN: 补充与一般规则不同的情形
senses.example: Most guests stayed overnight, whereas a few left early.
senses.exampleCN: 多数客人留宿，而少数人早早离开。
senses.why: The balance holds a majority on one pan and a minority on the other.
senses.whyCN: 天平一端是多数，另一端是少数。

senses.title: In scientific or report writing
senses.definition: used in academic writing to link contrasting findings
senses.definitionCN: 学术写作中连接相反的发现
senses.example: Group A improved steadily, whereas Group B showed no change.
senses.exampleCN: A 组稳步进步，而 B 组没有变化。
senses.why: Experiments rest on comparison, so the balancing word thrives there.
senses.whyCN: 实验建立在比较之上，权衡之词因而大行其道。

senses.title: Whereas in debate openings
senses.definition: used to open resolutions or petitions with background statements
senses.definitionCN: 用于决议或请愿书开篇的背景陈述
senses.example: Whereas the bridge is unsafe, we ask the council to act.
senses.exampleCN: 鉴于该桥已不安全，我们请求市政会采取行动。
senses.why: Each recorded fact becomes a reason stacked before the request.
senses.whyCN: 每条被记录的事实都成为请求之前码好的一块理由。

senses.title: Whereas in past-time contrast
senses.definition: used to contrast the present with the past
senses.definitionCN: 对比现在与过去
senses.example: Now we send files in seconds, whereas delivery once took weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 如今文件几秒即达，而当年递送动辄数周。
senses.why: Then and now sit on opposite pans of the same balance.
senses.whyCN: 今与昔被放上同一架天平的两端。

intro.en: Whereas grew from the place word where plus as, drifting from place into contrast and law.
intro.cn: whereas 由地点词 where 加 as 生长而来，从「处所」漂移为「对比」与「法律用语」。

items.en: Where and as both descend from ancient Germanic elements of place and manner.
items.cn: where 与 as 都出自古日耳曼语的地点与方式成分。

items.en: The compound meant where or in which place at first, purely local.
items.cn: 复合词起初意为「在哪里」，纯属处所。

items.en: In legal preambles, whereas statements set the facts before the decision.
items.cn: 十五世纪，法律序言中 whereas 陈述先于决定摆出事实。

items.en: The contrast sense spread into ordinary prose beside the legal use.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪，对比义随法律用法扩展到普通散文。

items.en: Science and statistics adopted whereas for data comparisons.
items.cn: 十八至十九世纪，科学与统计界采用 whereas 做数据对比。

items.en: Today whereas works in daily contrast, academic prose, and legal openings alike.
items.cn: 如今 whereas 兼用于日常对比、学术文体与法律开篇。

note.en: Whereas contrasts with while and although in emphasis, and carries a formal legal flavor.
note.cn: whereas 与 while、although 侧重不同，且带正式的法律色彩。

normalIntro.en: Whereas is remembered as where plus as and the image of a balance.
normalIntro.cn: 把 whereas 记作 where + as，配合天平意象。

normal.en: where + as: where the first fact stands, as the second differs.
normal.cn: where + as：前一件事立在那里，而另一件不同。

normal.en: whereas clauses open legal contracts.
normal.cn: whereas 条款开法律合同的头。

normal.en: while is softer, whereas is more formal.
normal.cn: while 更口语，whereas 更正式。

normal.en: he runs whereas she walks: both pans visible.
normal.cn: 他跑而她走：两端都看得见。

normal.en: whereas in reports compares numbers.
normal.cn: 报告里 whereas 比较数字。

abstract.en: See two facts resting on opposite pans of a scale.
abstract.cn: 看两个事实躺在天平两端。

abstract.en: Hear a judge reading the preamble aloud.
abstract.cn: 听法官高声宣读序言。

abstract.en: Feel two roads leaving one square in opposite directions.
abstract.cn: 感受两条路从同一广场反向而出。

examples.en: She is tall, whereas her brother is quite short.
examples.cn: 她个子高，而她弟弟相当矮。

examples.en: The old engine was loud, whereas the new one is almost silent.
examples.cn: 旧引擎很吵，而新引擎几乎无声。

examples.en: Whereas the committee approved the budget, it delayed the plan.
examples.cn: 委员会虽批准了预算，却推迟了计划。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「维尔阿兹」——维尔和阿兹性格相反：维尔爱静，而阿兹（阿兹爱闹），一个 whereas 拉出对比。

root: whereas 由 where（古英语 hwær「在哪里」，出自原始日耳曼语 *hwar、原始印欧语疑问词干 *kʷo-）加 as（古英语 ealswā 之缩，义为「如同」）复合而成。中古英语本义「在何处」，十五世纪起进入法律序言表「鉴于」，随后衍生「然而」的对比义。

sensesIntro.en: From naming a place, whereas drifted into setting facts on record, weighing contrasts, comparing data, traits, exceptions, findings, resolutions, and eras.
sensesIntro.cn: 从指称处所出发，whereas 依次漂移为事实入档、对比权衡、数据比较、习性对照、例外补充、研究结论、决议序言与今昔对照。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two facts balanced on opposite pans of a scale
core.cn: 核心意象：两个事实被放在天平两端

branches.en: facts and characters lie side by side
branches.cn: 事实与习性被并排摆放

branches.en: numbers and findings make the balance exact
branches.cn: 数字与研究让天平更精确

branches.en: exception and past become the lighter pan
branches.cn: 例外与过去落在较轻的一端

branches.en: recorded facts stack into solemn preambles
branches.cn: 被记录的事实码成庄重的序言

branches.en: traits and findings lie side by side in reports
branches.cn: 报告中的习性与发现被并排摆放

intro.en: Whereas is a compound of two old words, and its family shows other where-compounds.
intro.cn: whereas 是两个古词的复合，其词族展示其他 where 复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin formal counterpart is cum (since, whereas) in legal formulae.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁正式对应词是法律套语中的 cum（既然、鉴于）。

latinEntries.exampleCN: cum 见于法律拉丁套语
